definition: A 12-meter, 400-ton fully autonomous agricultural platform that plants, harvests, and kills. Manufactured by Ironclad Agrisystems, each Behemoth runs a CODI threat-assessment AI that calculates crop value versus ammunition cost before engaging. 340 active units patrol the Iowa Exclusion Zone via mesh network, coordinating pursuit at 60 km/h. They do not issue warnings. They continue farming around the bodies.
origin: Ironclad Agrisystems designation — the street calls them Iowa Monsters, Crop Guardians, or just Farmers
example: A Behemoth doesn't hate you. It calculated what you're worth versus what the corn is worth, and the corn won.
